activity_log.event: Redesign checkout jadi Order Online UX
activity_log.detail: Flow pilih paket -> ringkasan -> bayar (rekening + Order ID JG-XXXXXXXX) -> upload bukti -> menunggu verifikasi (timeline 4 langkah) -> sukses (masa aktif) / ditolak (coba lagi). src/lib/payment-plans.ts sumber tunggal plan; POST /api/payments/[id]/proof upload bukti (5MB, jpg/png/pdf); GET /api/payments/[id] + verifiedAt/subStartedAt/subExpiresAt; GET /api/payments user + planId; halaman Langganan + tabel Riwayat Pesanan; trust elements; fix race loader-vs-user stage (hydratedRef); fix redirect guest (bank hanya fetch saat login); QA suite _checkout 5/5 + full 28/28 PASS

Sales Readiness Final Audit (10 fase): landing PASS (2 catatan copy garansi/social proof), register/login PASS, role & plan security PASS (bypass test _security.spec.ts 6/6: gratis 403 semua fitur, pro hanya nilai, premium semua, user tak bisa verifikasi/lihat payment orang lain, upload exe/6MB ditolak), payment E2E PASS (amount server-side, planId whitelist, approval -> subscription active + users.plan + planExpires +6bln), payment security PASS (1 catatan MEDIUM: bukti transfer di public/uploads), mobile PASS (_mobile.spec.ts 4/4, 375/390/412 tanpa overflow), friction: HIGH x2 (klaim garansi 30 hari tanpa mekanisme refund, social proof angka hardcode), funnel mapping lengkap, tracking: TIDAK ADA sama sekali. CRITICAL BLOCKERS: NONE. Halaman /audit dibuat (tab per fase + tombol copy). Laporan: .agents/sales-readiness-audit.md

Quick Win 1-2 (copy landing): klaim 'Garansi 30 Hari Uang Kembali' & 'Enkripsi & Backup' diganti 'Coba Gratis Dulu — Tanpa Kartu Kredit' + 'Data Anda Aman — Akses Terproteksi'; rating '4.9 dari 281 guru aktif' & stats 281/1.200+/45/4.9 diganti angka fungsional (Rp0/10 detik/6+ fitur/1 tempat); testimoni fiktif (Bu Ratna dkk) & popup fake social proof diganti kartu manfaat + 'Tip Cepat' fitur. Quick Win 5 (tracking minimal): tabel events + POST /api/track (publik, whitelist 7 event: landing_view, register_started, register_completed, checkout_viewed, payment_created, payment_proof_submitted, payment_approved) + UTM (utm_source/medium/campaign/content via cookie jg_utm 30 hari) + GET admin utk lihat data; dedupe re-render via localStorage trackOnce 6 jam; tanpa password/token/proof binary; tracking tidak bisa ubah payment/plan (insert-only, whitelist event, GET admin-only). Test: _tracking.spec.ts 4/4. Backlog: .agents/BACKLOG.md (Private Payment Proof Storage, NON-BLOCKER).
